answer: The core sybil defence is a stake-backed registration bond every new identity must lock before transacting, gated by peer attestation. An attacker wanting a thousand sock puppets cannot post one bond and clone it: each identity locks its own bond plus a proof-of-work stamp. The velvet of trust stays thin until others vouch, so unattested clones never reach the refund pool. If an operator forges linked agents, colluders forfeit the stake and the reward they chased, a faint echo. Honest cost: one bond, repaid on exit. The nebula of fake wallets grows costly fast.
